headline: AAV2のVP1は、別の組み合わせでもインポーチンαに結合する
subhead: BR2が主要・副次どちらの結合ポケットにも入ることを、結晶構造3つで示した
target_en: AAV2 VP1 basic regions with mouse importin-α2

summary.question: AAV2 の核への移行にどの宿主インポーチンと VP1 のどの領域が関わるのかは、はっきりしていなかった。
summary.approach: VP1 の塩基性領域（BR1〜3）と IMPα2 の複合体の結晶構造を、野生型と BR1・BR3 変異体で解き、結合と核移行も測った。
summary.result: 野生型では BR1 と BR3 が副次・主要ポケットに入った。BR1 変異体では BR2 が副次ポケットに、BR3 変異体では BR2 が主要ポケットに入った。
summary.learned: BR のうち2つが無傷なら IMPα に結合して核へ移行でき、1つだけでは足りない。VP1 の核移行シグナルは、組み合わせが1通りに決まっていない。
summary.open: ペプチドでの結果であり、これらの配置がウイルス粒子全体の核移行に効くかは、今後の課題とされている。

question.quote: Despite this, neither the specific host importins (IMPs) involved nor the viral signals within that drive this process have been unequivocally identified.
It is there notable that the precise mechanisms governing its nuclear entry have remained unclear.

approach.quote: Here, we combine cellular, biophysical, structural, and computational modelling approaches to define the nuclear import mechanism of AAV2 VP1 at molecular resolution.
we determined crystal structures of AAV2 VP1-BR peptides bearing alanine substitutions in either BR1 (mBR1: K123A/R124A) or BR3 (mBR3: R168A/K169A/R170A) in complex with mIMPα2.

result.quote: The crystal structure of AAV2 VP1-BR in complex with mIMPα2 suggests that nuclear import of AAV2 VP1 is mediated by the IMPα/β1 heterodimer through recognition of a bipartite NLS formed by BR1 and BR3, which engage the minor and major binding sites of IMPα, respectively.
Notabley, BR2 is resolved in the minor binding site (Fig. 5A)
Conversely, in the AAV2 VP1-mBR3:mIMPα2 complex, BR2 occupies the major binding site

learned.quote: Importantly, simultaneous mutation of any two BRs completely abrogated both IMPα binding and nuclear import (Fig. 4), indicating that AAV2 VP1 can utilize multiple combinations of BR segments to form a functional bipartite NLS.
AAV2 VP1 does not possess a single canonical bipartite NLS but instead utilizes a flexible, modular nuclear localization architecture

open.quote: Future studies should investigate how these alternative NLS arrangements influence nuclear entry of intact virions

highlights.text: 野生型の結晶構造では見えなかった BR2 が、BR1 変異体では副次ポケットに、BR3 変異体では主要ポケットに収まった。BR2 はどちらのポケットにも入れる。

evidence.quote: Notably, mutation of BR2, which is not resolved in the AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 crystal structure, also significantly reduced nuclear import
Notabley, BR2 is resolved in the minor binding site (Fig. 5A)
Conversely, in the AAV2 VP1-mBR3:mIMPα2 complex, BR2 occupies the major binding site

highlights.text: BR1・BR2・BR3 のどれか1つを置換しても、IMPα7 への結合は 4〜14 倍弱まるだけで、核移行も残った。2つを同時に置換すると、核移行は完全になくなった。

evidence.quote: Surprisingly, substitution of either BR1 or BR3 reduced, but did not abolish, nuclear accumulation of AAV2 VP1-GFP (Fig. 4, B and C).

FP assays showed that individual substitutions in BR1 (KD ∼518 nM, ∼10 fold reduction), BR2 (KD ∼740 nM, ∼14 fold reduction), or BR3 (KD ∼207 nM, ∼4 fold reduction) reduced, but did not eliminate binding to IMPα7
In contrast, simultaneous substitutions of two BRs (mBR1+2, mBR1+3, or mBR2+3) completely abolished nuclear import

highlights.text: BR2 と BR3 の組み合わせで足りることから、BR1 を持たない VP2 も核へ移行できる理由になると論文は考える。また BR を1つずつ調節してカプシドの核への移行を設計する道を示唆する。

evidence.quote: The demonstration that the BR2-BR3 combination is sufficient to mediate productive IMPα recognition indicates that VP2 retains a fully functional bipartite NLS despite lacking BR1.
offers new opportunities to engineer capsid nuclear targeting by modulating individual BRs rather than introducing entirely new localization signals

lab_notes.expression: 大腸菌 pLysS で自動誘導発現（23 °C、30〜38 時間）。VP1-BR と mIMPα2 を別々に発現。
lab_notes.construct: VP1 の残基 115〜175（BR1〜3 を含む）を GST-TEV 融合で発現。IMPα は IBB ドメインを除いた ΔIBB。
lab_notes.purification: 溶解液を混ぜて HisTrap で精製し、TEV で GST を除いて Superdex 200 のゲルろ過にかけた。
lab_notes.sample_prep: ハンギングドロップ蒸気拡散法。野生型は 0.7 M クエン酸ナトリウム、pH 6.5 で 2 日で結晶化。変異ペプチドは 3:1 のモル比で混合。
lab_notes.data_collection: オーストラリアン・シンクロトロンの MX2 で収集。4OIH を探索モデルに Phaser で分子置換。

evidence.quote: AAV2 VP1-BR and mIMPα2 were individually overexpressed in E. coli pLysS cells using auto-induction method (64) at 23 °C, with shaking at 150 rpm for 30 to 38 h.
evidence.section: Recombinant bacterial protein expression and purification

evidence.quote: A gene fragment corresponding to residues 115 to 175 of VP1, encompassing BRs BR1-3
IMPα constructs used for crystallization, fluorescence polarization (FP), and EMSAs lacked the N-terminal IMPβ1 binding (IBB) domain (ΔIBB).
Eluted fractions were pooled and incubated overnight at 4 °C with TEV protease to remove the GST tag from AAV2 VP1-BR.
evidence.section: Recombinant bacterial protein expression and purification

evidence.quote: The sample was then subjected to size-exclusion chromatography using a HiLoad 26/600 Superdex 200 column
evidence.section: Recombinant bacterial protein expression and purification

evidence.quote: The AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 complex crystalized in a condition 0.7 M sodium citrate, 0.01 M DTT, 0.1 M Hepes (pH 6.5), yielding rod-shaped crystals after 2 days.
evidence.section: Crystallization, data collection and structure determination of AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 complexes

evidence.quote: AAV2 VP1-mBR1 and AAV2 VP1-mBR3 peptides were mixed with purified mIMPα2 at a 3:1 M ratio prior to crystallization.
evidence.section: Crystallization, data collection and structure determination of AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 complexes

evidence.quote: X-ray diffraction data were collected at the Australian Synchrotron on the MX2 beamline (66).
evidence.section: Crystallization, data collection and structure determination of AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 complexes

evidence.quote: Structures were solved by molecular replacement in Phaser (70) using the Protein Data Bank (PDB) entry 4OIH (54) as the search model.
evidence.section: Crystallization, data collection and structure determination of AAV2 VP1-BR:mIMPα2 complexes

editor_notes: FoldX の結合エネルギーは、本文と Table 1 で値と単位（kcal/mol と kJ/mol）が食い違っているため記事では使っていない。論文の分解能は 2.3/2.6/2.1 Å、PDB は 2.25/2.6/2.15 Å で、記事は PDB の値を採用。『初めて示した』という著者の主張は記事に載せていない。mBR2 の構造はなく、BR2 の役割は変異体 2 構造と変異の機能測定からの推定。legend_labels は未設定（IMPα と VP1 ペプチドの 2 鎖、render 後に確認）。
